BiblicalUsage: Jekonjah is Jeconiah, a Jewish king, the son of Jehoiakim. In 1 Chronicles 3:16, Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son. The fuller story is told on the Jeconiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jeconiah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
